7222102687877.title: Love Lahore
7222102687877.description:
Notes:
Floral – Spicy – Musky
Top note: Violet, Pear, Grapefruit, Aquatic notes
Middle note: Poppy, Violet, Rose, Geranium, Cedarwood
Base note: Amber and Musk
Size: 100/ML

+ Details
Love Lahore is a tribute to the city’s soulful heartbeat; romantic, spirited, and unforgettable. It opens with a luminous blend of violet, crisp pear, sparkling grapefruit, and fresh aquatic notes, creating a bright, airy introduction that instantly captivates.
The heart blooms with a rich floral tapestry of poppy, violet, rose, and geranium, subtly warmed by cedarwood to bring a gentle, spicy depth. Finally, the scent rests on a sensual base of amber and soft musk, leaving behind a warm, intimate trail that lingers beautifully.

+ About the Fragrance
A conversation with a friend can be so much more than words. When we speak with someone, we connect with every layer of their soul — their wounds, their dreams, their hopes, and their love.
There is power in tending to someone's whole being, and healing in allowing someone to listen to ours. And in the warm, welcoming embrace of Lahore, we discover love, friendship, and a deep sense of belonging.

7222102720645.title: Lush Lahore
7222102720645.description:
Notes:
 Fruity – Tasty
Top note: Marine, red fruits, peach
Middle note: Coconut and peony
Base note: Sandalwood and Tonka bean
Size: 100/ML

+Details

A vibrant celebration of Lahore’s irresistible charm, Lush Lahore is a fragrance that feels sun-kissed, playful, and effortlessly stylish. It opens with a refreshing burst of marine notes, uplifted by the juicy sweetness of red fruits and peach, creating a bright and inviting first impression.
At its heart, creamy coconut blends seamlessly with soft, romantic peony, adding a smooth, summery femininity to the scent. As it settles, warm sandalwood and the comforting richness of Tonka bean create a lingering base; soft, addictive, and undeniably memorable.

 

+About the Fragrance
In the moment of solitude amidst lush surroundings we discover strength not by escaping our feelings, but by embracing them. The scent of spring and blooming flora envelops us, inviting reflection.
 
Here we sit with our emotions, allowing them to wash over like gentle monsoon rain, confronting the voids rather than numbing them. In this serene embrace of the gardens of Lahore, we find clarity, acknowledging our inner selves in a world often filled with distractions.

7222102753413.title: Lust Lahore
7222102753413.description:
Notes

Floral-Oriental-Amber
Top note: Damascene Rose, sweet note, Jasmine, spicy notes
Middle note: Vanilla, Tuberose, mirabilis
Base note: Milk, Whipped cream, Patchouli, amber
Size: 100/ML

+ Details

Lust Lahore is an ode to the city after dark, intense, irresistible, and wrapped in a captivating glow. It begins with the lush romance of Damascene rose, touched with sweet accords, radiant jasmine, and a whisper of spicy notes, creating an opening that is both seductive and intriguing.
At its heart, creamy vanilla, intoxicating tuberose, and the velvety warmth of mirabilis unfold, adding depth and an alluring floral richness. As the fragrance settles, a decadent base of milk, whipped cream, earthy patchouli, and glowing amber lingers on the skin; sensual, smooth, and undeniably memorable.

 

+ About the Fragrance

All it takes is one chance encounter, one singular moment in time to completely change your life.  To crack your heart open, to introduce you to levels of care that you never knew existed. It’s risky to be unguarded but riskier to be tucked away from this feeling. You are here to risk your heart. You are here to connect. Connect to the notes of warm amber and rich sandalwood that linger on the skin, grounding you in the present moment while reminding you of the passionate journey you are on.
 ‘Lust Lahore’ is a declaration of your willingness to risk your heart and explore the myriad possibilities that await. Wear it as a reminder to never lose sight of the beauty and excitement that life has in store for you.
